assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: Nine independent conditional occurrences (seven Intimacy addresses, one Short message and one Birthday portfolio) with no inferred unlock level, calendar year or chronology among them and no placement relative to Main. The only time markers are local and asserted by Monaka: five in the morning and today in B0232, the new year in her B0235 pledge, and her sense of having spent a long time at Nanasta, which gives no duration. The boundary limits evidence, not knowledge: earlier experiences she reports, such as the teacher exchange and her work at different part-time workplaces, belong to her in every occurrence.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit, including the owner calibration rulings; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: One pattern recurs across the three dedicated readings and B0213 tests it against rivals: Monaka keeps proposing ways to participate (help at 魚晴, a gag unit with Matsuri, a conversation opener for Tomoe, a trip with Honoka as guide, a swimsuit job), each with a named want and a limiting detail (B0213 cumulative state). B0213 rejects three rival models with located cases: purely irresponsible (valued belonging B:P2-P3, shop effort C:P4, the airfare target E:P5), effortlessly socially competent (change and fish-name errors C:P3, the wording check D:P4, Tomoe's departure F:P5) and uniformly satisfied or acquisitive (B's 'enough' beside E and G). B0232 adds a remembered promise interrupting a return to sleep, and B0235 a search-oriented self-image beside being remembered at Nanasta. Not C: the readings name her motives but no rule for which wins when gratitude for the present and wanting something more conflict, and B0213 says each effect must be judged in its encounter.

No state sequence is available. B0213 says native menu order supplies neither unlock level nor chronology and refuses to place A as a later failed intervention in B0090's lateness; B0232 fixes no date or placement relative to Main; B0235 gives no common year or age and attributes her sense of accumulated time at Nanasta (P2-6) to her without a duration.

Located wording is local: the seven titles (寝る子は！, よくなくない？, 新アルバイト！, フリーターズ！, 旅行するなら！, 私たちの共通項, 水着、買いました！), the shop name 魚晴, テンジン・ストリート, and the Short message title 朝ですよー(´Д⊂ ｺﾞｼｺﾞｼ with its written sleep marker. B0213 notes pauses, elongated phrases, exclamation marks and a playful note as written features and infers no pitch, loudness or timing; the rest of her Japanese is paraphrased.

Ordinary conduct is the substance of all three readings but is mostly reported or proposed: an early-bedtime decision while still occasionally late (B0213 A:P2), reported shop help with errors (C), a fashion-trip dream with airfare as the first target (E), a swimsuit bought without an occasion and a proposed shoot to cover it (G), waking at five and asking whether to stay up (B0232 case 29), and a received birthday party (B0235). No outcome is shown: no attendance, saving, trip, shoot or later waking.

The manager is addressed in every occurrence and has no reply of his own. Others enter only through her report: Sawara's praise (B0213 C:P4), Matsuri as approachable and the checked compliment (D:P3-P4), Honoka named as a guide without acceptance (E:P4), Tomoe's lowered head and departure (F:P5), the promise with Coney (B0232 P1) and Nanasta's remembering (B0235 P2-6). B0213 keeps intention, attributed response and what a recipient feels apart, so no relationship-specific response rule is established.

Interior states are spoken self-reports: wanting to grow as an idol (B0213 A:P2), that present belonging may be enough (B:P2-P4), that trying was worthwhile (C:P4), worry that she said something odd again (D:P4), wishing she had talked longer with Tomoe (F:P5), indecision while sleepy (B0232 P2), and happiness at being remembered (B0235 P2-6). The readings attribute each to her and give no inner life beyond them.

One located friction: a represented query or challenge makes her insist that calling Matsuri childlike was a compliment and wonder whether she said something odd again (B0213 D:P4); Matsuri has no voiced objection and no apology is completed. The teacher exchange (B:P1) is a recollection, and Tomoe's departure (F:P5) is a failed connection, not a dispute.

No reading analyzes ethical reasoning by Monaka. The bust remark (B0213 F:P4) is read as a misjudged attempt at affiliation and the sexier-shots offer (G:P4) as a proposed work offer; neither is weighed as a moral choice.

Play is located in one reading: the wake-up arrangement likened to living together and then marked as playful (B0213 A:P3), the comic turn in dropping study (B:P4), the dramatized shop rescue with herself as heroic freeter (C:P2) and the wandering-part-timer rally revealed as a joke unit idea with Matsuri (D:P1-P2). Breadth across partners is untested.

Each curated unit is complete: B0213's seven Intimacy occurrences (family 200680), B0232's three-page Short message 402003201 and B0235's 19-page Birthday portfolio 404000003. Together they are nine short single-speaker side occurrences. The earlier Monaka readings (B0090, B0128, B0166 and later accounts) are context leads, not curated, and no voice, music or loop movie was heard or resolved.

Affirmative limits recur and B0213 interprets them as one construction, an expansive opening that meets a limiting detail: still occasionally late beside the early-bed plan (A:P2), errors with change and fish names (C:P3), a compliment she fears was odd (D:P4), Tomoe lowering her head and leaving (F:P5), the airfare not yet saved (E:P5) and a swimsuit with no occasion (G:P2). The reading uses them to reject an effortless-competence model, and B0232 and B0235 both refuse to read a reminder or a pledge as punctuality reform. Not C: the limits are interpreted in one reading, and the other two only restate that no reform is shown.

The readings establish that no chronology, calendar, year or unlock level orders the nine occurrences. The only markers are local and asserted: five in the morning and today (B0232 P0-P1, not a verified clock or date), the new year in her pledge (B0235 P16-18) and the one-year age difference she claims with Tomoe (B0213 F:P3, no exact ages).

scenario_readiness.note: The readings paraphrase almost all of her Japanese beyond titles and a few names, all voice cues are unheard (eight in B0235 alone), and B0213 declines to infer pitch, loudness or timing from punctuation. Generated lines would be fluent invention, not source-supported voice.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: Any one of the nine unordered occurrences; nothing before, after or between them, and no placement relative to Main.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: The manager as addressed listener without a reply of his own; the refusal applies equally to Sawara, Matsuri, Honoka, Tomoe, Coney or any other counterpart, none of whom has a turn in the evidence.
setting_constraints: Crossover, counterfactual or materially novel contexts beyond the nine located occurrences
Behavioral or dialogue simulation rather than bounded canon description

scenario_readiness.note: Nine short unordered monologue occurrences, with every counterpart's reply absent and B0213 saying each effect must be judged in its own encounter, cannot support a novel context.

Her ordinary plans and reports answer bounded canon questions about these occurrences, but the readings show no recipient's answer and no outcome (B0213 D:P4 and F:P5 keep intention apart from reception), so there is no procedure for an unfamiliar ordinary exchange.
No ethical deliberation by Monaka is analyzed in any reading.

B0213 A:P3 likens a wake-up arrangement with the manager to living together and then marks it as playful; the reading states that it establishes no cohabitation, accepted agreement or settled romantic relationship. That is an affirmative bound in the item, not silence.

Work is reported or proposed, never enacted: shop help told after the fact with errors (B0213 C), a proposed swimsuit shoot with no commission or acceptance (G:P3-P4), a joke unit with no membership or booking (D:P2), and an idol-work pledge that B0235 says is an intention, not completed work or career closure (P16-18). No professional decision procedure is supported.

known_limits.statement: The nine sources are independent conditional occurrences with no chronology, unlock level, year or placement relative to Main; B0213's A-G key, B0232's catalog order and B0235's source order route reading only, so no occurrence is a step in her development.
Only Monaka has authored turns. The manager's answers are absent or inferred from her uptake, and Sawara, Matsuri, Honoka, Tomoe and Coney enter only through her report, quotation or plan.

The early bedtime, the wake-up arrangement, the Fukuoka-4th trip and its airfare, Honoka's guidance, the swimsuit shoot, the early-rising habit and the idol-work pledge are decisions, proposals or intentions; none is shown completed.

She still admits occasional lateness beside the early-bed plan (B0213 A:P2), and B0232 and B0235 both decline to read the remembered promise or the birthday pledge as punctuality reform or repair of B0090's costs.

Her intended praise of Matsuri and her conversational opener with Tomoe are kept apart from what each recipient felt: Matsuri's response is not voiced, and Tomoe's lowered head permits only a bounded reading of discouragement, not a diagnosis or later reconciliation.
The offer to work at sexier shots (B0213 G:P4) is a non-graphic proposed work offer, not an actual shoot, accepted terms or consent to any future assignment.
No voice cue, music, sound effect or loop movie was heard, viewed or resolved in any reading, and the fixed sprites do not render waking, shop work or a swimsuit pose.

The earlier Monaka readings (B0090, B0128, B0166 and the later admitted accounts) are not curated on this subject, so the readings' comparisons with her lateness costs, school path, privacy misses and search for fit were not checked. Missing support is not evidence of absence.
Apart from titles, two names and a written marker, the readings paraphrase Monaka's Japanese, so self-reference, sentence endings and register are not in the curated evidence.
